skill_name: Discuss the threats of overusing technology
workflow: Overusing technology can bring many risks and threats to the individuals and societies. Excessive use of the internet and other technological devices can lead to isolation, anxiety, depression, addiction, and reduced physical activity. Without proper boundaries, it can also be used to access inappropriate content such as violence, pornography, drug use, and hate speech.
